mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stellar_points_product (name, product_type, points_price, stock, image_url, description, coupon_id, status, sort_order, create_time, create_user, update_time, update_user) VALUES (#{name}, #{productType}, #{pointsPrice}, #{stock}, #{imageUrl}, #{description}, #{couponId}, #{status}, #{sortOrder}, #{createTime}, #{createUser}, #{updateTime}, #{updateUser})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM stellar_points_product WHERE status = 1 AND stock > 0 ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE stellar_points_product SET stock = stock - 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND stock > 0
